## Iteration comparison
Iterations: 1 = dev tuning; 2 = error-analysis fixes; 3 = output guard + code date resolution; 4 = quote-grounded verifier + router v5; 5 = citation recovery + table-row quotes in code, procedure-vs-incident routing, item-centred queries, single-date leave requests. Each holdout set was written and committed **before** the fixes of the iteration it evaluates, and measured on the system before and after those fixes.

**Test split across iterations** (seen during development, so optimistic from iteration 2 on):
